Shortcut Trick\n

When the Cost Price (CP) of two articles is the same, the net profit or loss percentage is the average of their individual profit or loss percentages.

\n

Net Profit or Loss % = (P1 + P2) ÷ 2

\n

⇒ Net % = (+12% − 8%) ÷ 2

\n

⇒ Net % = +4% ÷ 2 = +2%

\n

Since the sign is positive, there is an overall profit of 2%.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 2% Profit.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Profit on the 1st car = 12%

\n

Loss on the 2nd car = 8%

\n

Cost Price (CP) of both cars is the same.

\n

Calculation:

\n

⇒ Let the CP of each car be 100.

\n

⇒ Total CP of both cars = 100 + 100 = 200

\n

⇒ SP of the 1st car (at 12% profit) = 100 + 12 = 112

\n

⇒ SP of the 2nd car (at 8% loss) = 100 − 8 = 92

\n

⇒ Total SP of both cars = 112 + 92 = 204

\n\n Shortcut Trick\n

जब दो वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य (CP) समान होता है, तो शुद्ध लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत उनके व्यक्तिगत लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत का औसत होता है।

\n

शुद्ध लाभ या हानि % = (P1 + P2) ÷ 2

\n

⇒ शुद्ध % = (+12% − 8%) ÷ 2

\n

⇒ शुद्ध % = +4% ÷ 2 = +2%

\n

चूंकि चिन्ह धनात्मक है, कुल मिलाकर 2% का लाभ हुआ है।

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 2% लाभ है।

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

दिया गया है:

\n

पहली कार पर लाभ = 12%

\n

दूसरी कार पर हानि = 8%

\n

दोनों कारों का क्रय मूल्य (CP) समान है।

\n

गणना:

\n

⇒ माना प्रत्येक कार का क्रय मूल्य 100 है।

\n

⇒ दोनों कारों का कुल क्रय मूल्य = 100 + 100 = 200

\n

⇒ पहली कार का विक्रय मूल्य (12% लाभ पर) = 100 + 12 = 112

\n

⇒ दूसरी कार का विक्रय मूल्य (8% हानि पर) = 100 − 8 = 92

\n

⇒ दोनों कारों का कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 112 + 92 = 204

\n\n\n\n

⇒ शुद्ध लाभ = कुल विक्रय मूल्य − कुल क्रय मूल्य

\n

⇒ शुद्ध लाभ = 204 − 200 = 4

\n

⇒ कुल लाभ % = (लाभ ÷ कुल क्रय मूल्य) x 100

\n

⇒ कुल लाभ % = (4 ÷ 200) x 100 = 2%

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 2% लाभ है।

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Case 1: Same Cost Price (CP)

\n

यदि दो वस्तुएँ समान क्रय मूल्य पर खरीदी जाती हैं, एक x% लाभ पर बेची जाती है और दूसरी y% हानि पर, तो शुद्ध लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत (x − y) ÷ 2 द्वारा दिया जाता है।

\n

Case 2: Same Cost Price & Equal % Value

\n

यदि दो वस्तुएँ समान क्रय मूल्य पर खरीदी जाती हैं, एक x% लाभ पर बेची जाती है और दूसरी x% हानि पर, तो हमेशा कोई समग्र लाभ और कोई समग्र हानि नहीं होती है (0% शुद्ध परिवर्तन)।

\n

Case 3: Same Selling Price (SP)

\n

यदि दो वस्तुएँ समान विक्रय मूल्य पर बेची जाती हैं, एक x% लाभ पर और दूसरी x% हानि पर, तो हमेशा कुल मिलाकर शुद्ध हानि होती है जो (x2 ÷ 100)% के बराबर होती है।

"end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

Initial Ratio of Gold to Copper = 2 ∶ 1 (Total = 3 units = 60 Grams ⇒ 1 unit = 20 Grams)

\n

Final Ratio of Gold to Copper = 1 ∶ 2

\n

Since Gold remains unchanged, equate the Gold units by multiplying the final ratio by 2 ⇒ 2 ∶ 4

\n

Increase in Copper = 4 − 1 = 3 units ⇒ Added Copper = 3 × 20 = 60 Grams.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 60 Grams.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Total weight of initial alloy = 60 Grams

\n

Initial ratio of Gold to Copper = 2 ∶ 1

\n

Final ratio of Gold to Copper = 1 ∶ 2

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

Let the initial weight of Gold be 2x and Copper be x.

\n

⇒ Total initial weight = 2x + x = 60

\n

⇒ 3x = 60 ⇒ x = 20 Grams

\n

⇒ Initial quantity of Gold = 2 × 20 = 40 Grams

\n

⇒ Initial quantity of Copper = 20 Grams

\n

Let y Grams of pure copper be added to the mixture.

\n

⇒ New quantity of Copper = (20 + y) Grams

\n

Since the new ratio of Gold to Copper is 1 ∶ 2:

\n

⇒ 40 / (20 + y) = 1 / 2

\n

⇒ 20 + y = 80

\n

⇒ y = 60 Grams

\n

∴ The correct answer is 60 Grams.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Constant Element Concept

\n

When only one component of a mixture is altered (added or removed), the absolute quantity of the other component remains unchanged. Equating the constant component's parts across the initial and final ratios provides the fastest way to solve mixture problems.

\n

Rule of Alligation

\n

Used to find the exact ratio in which two distinct mixtures must be mixed. Formula: (Quantity of cheaper ÷ Quantity of dearer) = (Price of dearer − Mean price) ÷ (Mean price − Price of cheaper).

\n

Replacement Formula

\n

If from a vessel containing x units of a pure liquid, y units are drawn out and replaced with water, and this process is repeated n times, the amount of pure liquid left = x × (1 − y/x)n.

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

1 इकाई → 20

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

∴ सही उत्तर 60 ग्राम है।

"solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

Surface Area = 4πr2 = 30,184 cm2

\n

r2 = 30184 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 343 × 7 = 2401 ⇒ r = 49 cm

\n

Volume = (Surface Area × r) ÷ 3 = (30184 × 49) ÷ 3

\n

In terms of options: Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 492 = (88 × 7 / 3) × 492 = (616/3) × 492

\n

∴ The correct answer is 616/3 × (49)2 cm3.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Surface area of the sphere = 30,184 cm2

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr2

\n

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr3

\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r2 = 30,184

\n

⇒ (88/7) × r2 = 30,184

\n

⇒ r2 = (30184 × 7) ÷ 88

\n

⇒ r2 = 343 × 7 = 2401

\n

⇒ r = √2401 = 49 cm

\n

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 49 × 49

\n

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 22 × 7 × 49 × 49

\n

⇒ Volume = (616/3) × (49)2 cm3

\n

∴ The correct answer is 616/3 × (49)2 cm3.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Volume and Surface Area of Hemisphere

\n

For a hemisphere of radius r, Volume = (2/3)πr3, Curved Surface Area = 2πr2, and Total Surface Area = 3πr2.

\n

Relationship between Volume and Surface Area of Sphere

\n

The Volume (V) of a sphere can be expressed in terms of its Surface Area (S) as V = (S × r) ÷ 3.

\n

Archimedes Principle for Sphere

\n

The volume of a sphere is two-thirds the volume of its circumscribing cylinder with the same radius and height.दिया गया है:

Given: 

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 10 = [(136.4 - CP)/ CP] × 100 

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = 10%

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = [(SP - CP)/ CP]× 100 

\n\n

गणना

\n\n

⇒ 10 = [(136.4 - CP)/ CP] × 100 

\n\n

⇒ 10 CP = 13640 - 100 CP 

\n\n

⇒ 110 CP = 13640 

\n\n

⇒ CP = 124 रुपये प्रति किग्रा

\n\n

माना कि, पहली किस्म की चाय की मात्रा = x

\n\n

माना कि, दूसरी किस्म की चाय की मात्रा = y 

\n\n

प्रश्न के अनुसार:

\n\n

120 × x + 130 × y = (x + y) 124

\n\n

120x + 130y = 124x + 124y 

\n\n

6y = 4x 

\n\n

x : y = 3 : 2

\n\n

∴ अभीष्ट अनुपात 3 : 2 है।  

\n\n

Shortcut Trick 

\n\n

⇒ मिश्रण का CP = 136.4/110 × 100 = 124 रुपये प्रति किग्रा

\n\n

\n\n

अनुपात 3 : 2 है।

"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Calculation

\n\n

The greatest three digit number = 999

\n\n

To find the divisible number, an LCM of given four numbers is required,

\n\n

Factors of 12 = 3 × 4 = 22 × 3

\n\n

Factors of 3 = 3 × 1

\n\n

Factors of 36 = 4 × 9 = 32 × 22

\n\n

Factors of 24 = 3 × 8 = 3 × 23

\n\n

LCM of (3, 12, 24 and 36) = 23 × 32 = 72

\n\n

On dividing 999 by 72, the remainder 63,

\n\n

∴ Largest divisible number = 999 – 63 = 936

\n\n

The answer is 936.

गणना:

\n\n

तीन अंकों की सबसे बड़ी संख्या = 999

\n\n

विभाज्य संख्या ज्ञात करने के लिए, दी गई चार संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) आवश्यक है,

\n\n

12 के गुणनखंड = 3 × 4 = 22 × 3

\n\n

3 के गुणनखंड = 3 × 1

\n\n

36 के गुणनखंड = 4 × 9 = 32 × 22

\n\n

24 के गुणनखंड = 3 × 8 = 3 × 23

\n\n

(3, 12, 24 और 36) का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य = 23 × 32 = 72

\n\n

999 को 72 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल के रूप में 63 प्राप्त होता है।

\n\n

∴ सबसे बड़ी विभाज्य संख्या = 999 – 63 = 936

\n\n

सही उत्तर 936 है।

Given:

\n\n

A policeman notices a thief from a distance = 85 m.

\n\n

A policeman runs at the rate of 8 km/hr

\n\n

And thief run at the rate of 7 km/hr

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Distance = speed x time

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Relative speed = (8 - 7)km/hr = 1 km/hr

\n\n

Time = 85/(1 × 5/18)

\n\n

⇒ 17 × 18 sec = 306 seconds

\n\n

= 306/60 = 5.1 minutes

\n\n

∴ The answer is 5.1 minutes.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

एक पुलिसकर्मी, चोर को 85 मीटर की दूरी से देखता है।

\n\n

एक पुलिसकर्मी 8 किमी/घंटा की गति से दौड़ता है। 

\n\n

और चोर 7 किमी/घंटा की गति से दौड़ता है। 

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

दूरी = गति × समय

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

सापेक्ष गति = (8 - 7) किमी/घंटा = 1 किमी/घंटा

\n\n

ఇచ్చినది:

\n\n

ఒక పోలీసు దొంగని గమనించిన దూరం = 85 మీ

\n\n

ఒక పోలీసు గంటకు 8 కి.మీ వేగంతో పరుగెత్తాడు

\n\n

మరియు దొంగ గంటకు 7 కి.మీ వేగంతో పరుగెత్తాడు

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

దూరం = వేగం x సమయం

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

సాపేక్ష వేగం = (8 - 7)కి.మీ/గంట = 1 కి.మీ/గంట

\n\n

సమయం = 85/(1 × 5/18)

\n\n

⇒ 17 × 18 సెకను = 306 సెకన్లు

\n\n

= 306/60 = 5.1 నిమిషాలు

\n\n

∴ సమాధానం 5.1 నిమిషాలు.

\n", "mr": "\n

दिलेले आहे:

\n\n

चोर आणि पोलीस यांच्यातील अंतर = 85 मीटर 

\n\n

एक पोलीस ताशी 8 किमी या वेगाने धावतो.

\n\n

आणि चोर ताशी 7 किमी या वेगाने धावतो.

\n\n

वापरलेले सूत्र:

\n\n

अंतर = वेग x वेळ

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

सापेक्ष गती = (8 - 7)किमी/तास = 1 किमी/तास

\n\n

वेळ = 85/(1 × 5/18)

\n\n

⇒ 17 x 18 सेकंद = 306 सेकंद

\n\n

= 306/60 = 5.1 मिनिटे

\n\n

∴ उत्तर = 5.1 मिनिटे.

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

একজন পুলিশ একজন চোরকে লক্ষ্য করে যেখান থেকে সেই দূরত্ব = 85 মি

\n\n

একজন পুলিশ 8 কিমি/ঘন্টা বেগে দৌড়াচ্ছে

\n\n

আর চোর 7 কিমি/ঘন্টা বেগে দৌড়াচ্ছে 

\n\n

অনুসৃত সূত্র:

\n\n

দূরত্ব = গতি x সময়

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

আপেক্ষিক গতি = (8 - 7)কিমি/ঘণ্টা = 1 কিমি/ঘন্টা

\n\n

সময় = 85/(1 x 5/18)

\n\n

⇒ 17 x 18 সেকেন্ড = 306 সেকেন্ড

\n\n

= 306/60 = 5.1 মিনিট

\n\n

∴ উত্তরটি হল 5.1 মিনিট।

1/4 part sold at = 25% profit

The remaining sell at a profit of 30%.

\n\n

Total profit = 1980

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Profit from each part = quantity × profit percentage

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the total number of articles be 120.दिया गया है:

\n\n

1/3 भाग को बेचा गया है = 18% लाभ पर 

\n\n

1/4 भाग को बेचा गया = 25% लाभ पर 

\n\n

शेष को 30% लाभ पर बेचा गया है।

\n\n

कुल लाभ = 1980

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

प्रत्येक भाग से प्राप्त लाभ = मात्रा × लाभ प्रतिशत

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

The correct answer is: let the cat out of the bag

\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • The idiom "let the cat out of the bag" means to reveal a secret or disclose something that was supposed to be kept confidential. (किसी रहस्य को प्रकट करना या किसी ऐसी बात का खुलासा करना जिसे गोपनीय रखा जाना चाहिए)
    • \n\t
  • It suggests that someone has unintentionally or carelessly disclosed information that was meant to be kept hidden.\n\t
      \n\t\t
    • Example: Tom couldn't contain his excitement and accidentally let the cat out of the bag about the surprise vacation.
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n
\n\n

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n\n
    \n\t
  • "Let the chance slip by" means to miss or fail to take advantage of an opportunity. (किसी अवसर का लाभ उठाने में चूक जाना या असफल होना)

      \n\t
    • The present progressive tense, also known as the present continuous tense, is a verb form that indicates an ongoing action in the present.
      • \n\t
    • It is formed by using the present tense of the auxiliary verb "to be" (am, is, are) followed by the present participle (the -ing form) of the main verb.
      • \n\t
    • Structure: Why+Auxiliary Verb (Am/Is/Are)+Subject+Present Participle (Verb + -ing)+?\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Example: Why is she studying for her exams?
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • So, the correct answer is Option 2.
      \n\t​
      • \n
